I will use my own rice seed from last season because it grew well and I do not want to spend money on new seed. I will buy two bags of NPK fertilizer from the dealer and carry some cow manure to the plot, because the ground needs food for the rice to fill properly. My family will pull the weeds by hand and do all the work on this plot - it is not big, only less than half a hectare, so we do not need to hire anyone. I do not spray chemicals because they cost too much, and I will wait for the rains.
